texts.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会将目光转向这片星河的其他地方。所有舰队聚集起来，载运着无数狂热战士。尽管他们数个月之前还是刀兵相见的敌人，但现在，他们是渴望一同对外战争扩张的同志了。
texts.en:
For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste and accomplished what most thought impossible. Through a combination of guile, charisma and military genius, the newly crowned Great Khan has won the utter loyalty and devotion of all [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] factions.

Now that they are no longer busy killing each other, the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their attention elsewhere. Great fleets are massing for war, crewed by eager warriors who are now steadfast comrades in arms despite having been mortal enemies mere months ago.

texts.zh:
我是[raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName]，是[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗，我在这里向整个星系宣布，我们即将迎来新时代。[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]为了荣耀和资源而彼此争斗的黑暗时代已经结束了。

我向我的人民保证，新建立的伟大帝国将让[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]物种的名字永远刻在星系编年史中。

那些企图阻碍我们的人给我记好了：我将不惜一切代价让我的人民实现自己的抱负，如果你们胆敢反抗我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]必将消灭你们。
texts.en:
I am [raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName], Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and I am here to announce to the galaxy that a new age is upon us. The dark era where [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would senselessly butcher one another for scraps of resources or a misguided sense of honor has finally come to an end.

I have solemnly promised my people a new beginning through the formation of a great empire that will forever enshrine the name of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] species in the annals of galactic history.

To those who would stand in our way, know this: I will stop at nothing to realize the true destiny of my people. If you oppose us, the [raider_khanate.GetName] will grind you into dust.

texts.zh:
近期，一个处于[awakened_horde.GetName]控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
texts.en:
The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the [awakened_horde.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has convinced the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put aside their differences for the sake of continued survival.

Great war fleets from previously hidden anchorages are being crewed by eager [From.GetSpeciesName] warriors and restored into working order. Under the inspired leadership of their Great Khan, they now demand vengeance from the galaxy for their lost kin.

# 战争之鼓 / The Drums of War

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/first_contact_NPC_country_types_events.txt:1325-1360

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 隐藏的 first_contact_critters.1000 在与觉醒的掠夺者（awakened_marauders）首次接触时运行：建立通信，然后按全局标志 horde_triggered 分流。
  Hidden first_contact_critters.1000 runs on first contact with awakened marauders: it establishes communications and then splits on the global flag horde_triggered.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 没有 horde_triggered → marauder.501「战争的鼓声」（大汗登场），其后 marauder.502 并触发危机时间线 timeline.63；已有 → marauder.526「沉睡者苏醒」，同样接 502。
  No horde_triggered -> marauder.501 "The Drums of War" (the Great Khan appears), followed by marauder.502 and the crisis timeline event timeline.63; otherwise -> marauder.526 "The Sleeper Awakes", also leading to 502.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 501 与 526 互斥；之后交给大汗危机故事。
  501 and 526 are exclusive; afterwards the Great Khan crisis stories take over.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
- 不确定：marauder.502 及其后续属于大汗危机故事，由其他审阅者负责。
